company: The One Enterprise Public Company Limited

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Improve data testing, documentation, lineage, and reliability of analytical models.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD is dominated by trust, reliability, documentation, and data quality/governance language throughout with no velocity/speed phrases present.
evidence.domain_risk: enabling subscription growth, advertising optimization, experimentation, customer engagement, and executive reporting
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a media/streaming (OTT) company's product, subscription, and advertising analytics — errors affect business decisions (revenue, churn, ad monetization) without regulatory or financial-audit consequence.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product; Marketing; Content; Finance; Operations; Leadership; Data Engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity: the oneD team... Partner with Data Engineers to improve upstream data quality and source data consistency
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named data team (oneD) exists with distinct roles (Data Engineers as partners) and multiple named tools/warehouses in responsibilities, indicating a growing, multi-role but not yet fully mature/specialised data organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Define, document, and maintain business metrics including Active Users, Paid Subscribers, Churn, Retention, Renewal, Reactivation, Conversion, Watch Starts, Revenue, ARPU, and LTV.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Extremely precise, domain-specific metric names and concrete deliverables (AVOD/SVOD analytics, specific KPIs, named warehouses) give a very clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: enabling subscription growth, advertising optimization, experimentation, customer engagement, and executive reporting
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves commercial (subscription/ad monetization/revenue), product (experimentation, personalization, content), and finance (executive reporting) functions with genuinely equal weight across sections.
evidence.autonomy_level: Act as the owner of business-facing metric definitions and trusted datasets... Support product growth initiatives through trusted subscription and engagement datasets
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns and defines metric standards and business logic (strategic) while also building specific datasets in service of product, marketing, and advertising initiatives (execution), giving a mixed signal.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools for the candidate's own work or AI-consuming data infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Improve data testing, documentation, lineage, and reliability of analytical models.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing appears as a named, owned responsibility under a dedicated "Data Quality, Documentation & Governance" section with action verbs (improve, reduce duplicated logic), not just a tool in a requirements list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Enable stakeholders to make faster and more confident decisions through reliable data assets.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability and trust framing recurs throughout ("trusted data models", "reliable data assets", "source-of-truth datasets") as a secondary theme behind the primary delivery/enablement framing, without regulatory or compliance risk language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Reduce duplicated business logic across reports, dashboards, and ad-hoc analysis.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds new analytical models/datasets across multiple domains (greenfield) and consolidates/fixes duplicated business logic and upstream data quality issues (fix_scale), giving a mixed signal.
evidence.loss_aversion: "Enable stakeholders to make faster and more confident decisions through reliable data assets" reflects concern for trust/reliability of data reaching decision-makers, secondary to delivery framing — moderate.
